title: Tesla's wireless power and claimed over-unity

tellings.quote: and frankly uh there's are accounts that suggest that or not suggest that state that that Tesla believed that he was even able to achieve so-called overunity.

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla, known for his work on sending electric power without wires, believed he had achieved "over-unity," meaning a machine that puts out more energy than goes into it. A Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell says there are accounts that state this outright, though he does not name them. If true, it would mean Tesla thought he had found a nearly free source of energy.
